title: The Final Colony
author: Zephyrine Oyelaran
blurb: Rafael Underhill, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
